overview: The School Committee approved a material change for the Roberts Elementary playground surface and reviewed district-wide MCAS performance data. The meeting also featured reports on elementary math instruction, student commuting safety initiatives, and coordinated fundraising efforts by school PTOs.

items.title: Approval of Minutes, Bills, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the October 1 meeting, the transfer of funds, and payrolls.

items.title: Report of Secretary
items.summary: Secretary Kathy Kreatz provided updates on a hot water tank replacement at the high school and the inspection process for a new slide at Columbus Elementary.

items.title: Committee of the Whole: MCAS Overview
items.summary: Accepted a report on district MCAS performance that highlighted significant growth in English Language Arts and identified math as a priority area for future improvement.

items.title: Roberts Elementary Playground Surface
items.summary: Approved switching the Roberts playground surface to a rubber bond pour-in-place material and authorized soliciting additional quotes after the originally selected tiles were discontinued.

items.title: Elementary PTO Joint Fundraising Presentation
items.summary: Representatives from elementary school PTOs presented several collaborative fundraising initiatives, including a Disney vacation raffle and a basketball game featuring the Harlem Wizards.

items.title: Report of the Superintendent
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on district activities, including the opening of the vocational bistro and community fundraising events by Kiwanis and local businesses.

items.title: Math Learning Walk Findings
items.summary: Approved a report on elementary math instruction findings based on classroom observations conducted using core actions established by Lesley University.

items.title: Puerto Rico Field Trip Approval
items.summary: Approved a service-learning field trip to Puerto Rico for 39 students scheduled for February 2019.

items.title: Safe Routes to School Presentation
items.summary: Approved a report from Safe Routes to School and city officials regarding student pedestrian safety, commuting trends, and infrastructure grants for several elementary schools.

items.title: Coordinated Program Review Update
items.summary: Staff provided an overview of the Department of Elementary and Secondary Education's comprehensive six-year evaluation of special education, civil rights, and vocational programs.
